data.content:
========================= I-0498 memory open
MATHLIB GAP (v4.31.0, fabf563a7c95, verified by machine probe 2026-07-28 run 0073): 'reduced after base change to k-bar => geometrically reduced' DOES NOT EXIST, and the transcendental case is why.

WHAT IS THERE: Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced (RingTheory/Nilpotent/GeometricallyReduced.lean:54) with isGeometricallyReduced_field_iff (:62) reducing it to IsReduced (AlgebraicClosure k ⊗[k] A), and an instance at :71 giving IsReduced (K ⊗[k] A) for ALGEBRAIC K/k.

WHAT IS NOT THERE, all three probed with lean_run_code:
 1. the same without [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] — no instance, exact? finds nothing.
 2. the crux 'k alg closed, A reduced, K/k arbitrary => IsReduced (K ⊗[k] A)' — absent.
 3. any bridge from the scheme class GeometricallyReduced (AlgebraicGeometry/Geometrically/Reduced.lean:44, defined as  quantifying over ALL fields) to the algebra class. grep -rl IsGeometricallyReduced Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/ returns NOTHING.

DEAD END WORTH RECORDING SEPARATELY: the obvious dodge does not work. mathlib's smooth_of_grpObj consumes GeometricallyReduced but its proof only uses the k-bar fibre, so a variant hypothesised on IsReduced (X ×_k k-bar) looks like an [S] bypass. It is not: 'IsReduced G + [IsAlgClosed K] => GeometricallyReduced f' is ALSO absent, because that upgrade IS probe 3. Option (b) relocates the content, it does not remove it. The one genuinely cheap route is upstream — smooth_of_grpObj_of_isAlgClosed (Group/Smooth.lean:40) is , so downstream projects cannot reach the useful half; making it public would leave a consumer needing only reducedness over k-bar.

WHO THIS BITES: any lane trying to prove GeometricallyReduced of a group scheme from reducedness of a geometric fibre — AJCR's W5-S1, and AJC's Pic0AbelianVariety.smooth sorry. Full analysis in AJCR informal/w5-s-worksheet.md §2.1.

========================= I-0567 memory open
A 'private' MATHLIB LEMMA IS NOT A WALL, and a walled ROUTE is not a walled theorem. Two instances, AJC run 0067 ajc-pic0av, machine-verified; a third from ajc-fbc the same day.

1 PRIVATE HIDES THE NAME, NOT THE PROOF. smooth_of_grpObj requires GeometricallyReduced (all field base changes). It reduces internally to reducedness over one algebraic closure, but via 'private smooth_of_grpObj_of_isAlgClosed'. BOTH AJC and AJCR independently concluded the cheap route was an UPSTREAM PR making it public, and recorded that as the wall (I-0495). Wrong: the proof uses only public API (smoothLocus_eq_top_iff, dense_smoothLocus_of_perfectField, preimage_smoothLocus_eq, nonempty_inter_closedPoints, pointEquivClosedPoint, GrpObj.mulRight, jacobsonSpace). Transcribed verbatim -- same set_options, same opens -- ZERO errors first try. Picard/GroupSchemeSmoothAlgClosed.lean. The reduction is STRICT: the converse (IsReduced over kbar => GeometricallyReduced) is genuinely absent from mathlib v4.31, so the wall was an artefact of WHICH INTERMEDIATE STATEMENT HAPPENED TO BE EXPORTED.

2 THE ROUTE CAN BE THE OVER-STRONG THING. Properness of Pic0 carried a standing caveat (I-0074 Caveat 2): Kleiman argues via QUASI-PROJECTIVITY, absent from mathlib v4.31. But properness has another standard criterion -- the VALUATIVE criterion, Stacks 01KF, shipped as UniversallyClosed.of_valuativeCriterion. Against it the residue is a LIFTING statement, and the other three IsProper conjuncts were already theorems in the file, including a quasiCompact whose docstring said it was 'not needed for the proper assembly'.

THE GENERAL RULE, ajc-fbc's formulation after hitting the same thing on flat exactness with no visibility issue at all: THE FRONTIER IS OFTEN AN ARTEFACT OF HOW STRONGLY THE OBLIGATION WAS STATED. It gets phrased at the strongest generality keeping the sentence true, that becomes the wall, and the consumer only instantiates it somewhere weaker. Case 2 is the same failure one level up: measure what the CONCLUSION needs, not what the source proof used.

ACT ON IT: (a) read a private proof's script and check each name's visibility before pricing a PR; (b) when a docstring blames missing library vocabulary, enumerate the OTHER standard criteria for that conclusion; (c) the new route's side conditions are often already proved and filed as 'not needed'; (d) measure with a probe AND a control, gate assumed not synthesised, control must still report sorryAx.
